narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>He drinks milk every day, so it is seven glasses in a week.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But each day is only half a glass, and not a whole one.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Seven whole glasses would be twice too much.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 7 glasses; seven full glasses are drawn next to seven half glasses; the bubble is struck through

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, count the halves. Two halves make a glass, so seven halves is a little over three glasses.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the words count the halves, two halves make a glass appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip counts one whole glass for each day and gets seven glasses. Each day is only half a glass.
